entities.name: Sidar Jabari
entities.description: A sidar and Zhalfirin leader who warns Kaervek.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A villain who claims Mangara's power and means to rule Jamuraa.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: Former ruler of Jamuraa whose power Kaervek claims; he won the Quirion's loyalty centuries ago.

entities.name: Rashida Scalebane
entities.description: Zhalfirin dragon-slayer who measures victories in children freed from nightmares.

entities.name: Asmira
entities.description: Holy Avenger and, after the Council of Voices' death, sole voice of Femeref leadership.

entities.name: Hakim
entities.description: Loreweaver who tells of Kaervek's invasion.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Wizard and court mage who unified Zhalfir's houses into guilds.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Woman who has hidden from Zhalfir for centuries.

entities.name: Purraj of Urborg
entities.description: Figure who sings the Song of Blood.

entities.name: Scout Ekemet
entities.description: Scout whose final journal records the Uuserk Trail.

entities.name: Imwita
entities.description: Zhalfirin artificer who spoke last words.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Nation of Jamuraa whose houses were unified into guilds.

entities.name: Council of Voices
entities.description: Femeref leaders slain in one terrible instant.

entities.name: Shadow Guild
entities.description: Guild keeping the dead so others may live.

entities.name: Civic Guild
entities.description: Guild with a maxim about condemning the innocent.

entities.name: Shaper Guild
entities.description: Guild that shapes the world in Zhalfir's image.

entities.name: Uuserk
entities.description: Swamp whose entities spread to Zhalfir.

entities.name: Burning Isles
entities.description: Home to a dozen lords claiming dominion.

events.summary: Kaervek claims he has taken Mangara's power.
events.quote: "Mangara is gone. Who among you doubts that I have taken his power?"

events.summary: Sidar Jabari warns Kaervek that Suq'Ata, Femeref and Zhalfirins are now joined.
events.quote: "Suq'Ata believe in trade; Femeref, alms; Zhalfirins, steel. Be warned, Kaervek—now we are joined."

events.summary: Hakim recalls portents before the war: villages in ash, farmers taken, foul beasts.
events.quote: "The days before the war were filled with strange portents: scouts and herders spoke of villages reduced to ash, of farmers taken from their fields, and of foul beasts roaming the plains in packs.

events.summary: Hakim recalls Zhalfir's dominance and Kaervek's shocking invasion.
events.quote: Kaervek's invasion shocked us all."

events.summary: Mangara won the loyalty of the Quirion centuries ago by supporting their independence.
events.quote: Centuries ago, Mangara won the loyalty of the Quirion not by ruling their minds but by supporting their independence.

events.summary: Hakim tells that farmers vanished in the mists and none guessed the truth.
events.quote: "Across the plains, farmers who braved the mists began to vanish. Most blamed the goblins; none guessed the truth."

events.summary: The Council of Voices is slain in one instant, leaving Asmira sole leader of Femeref.
events.quote: But in one terrible instant, they were slain, leaving Asmira as the sole voice of leadership."

events.summary: Foul entities of the Uuserk swamp spread their influence into the heart of Zhalfir.
events.quote: "The foul entities of the Uuserk swamp had never before dared to spread their influence to the very heart of Zhalfir."

events.summary: Of six scouts down the Uuserk Trail, only one returned, sobbing with horror.
events.quote: "Of the six who went down the Uuserk Trail to scout ahead, one returned.

events.summary: Scout Ekemet records deaths with no time to scream.
events.quote: "I don't know what takes them; they die around me without time to scream."

events.summary: Kaervek says night stalkers of Urborg are willing tools in plundering Femeref.
events.quote: Their sad eagerness to elevate themselves makes them willing tools in the plundering of little Femeref."

events.summary: Kaervek declares Jamuraa will look to him alone as leader.
events.quote: Jamuraa will look to only one leader: me."

events.summary: Kaervek foretells that his victims' memory will fade.
events.quote: "The memory of your existence will fade like the final stars of morning."

events.summary: Kaervek sells secrets of Phyrexia at a steep price.
events.quote: "The secrets of Phyrexia are expensive. You will pay in brass and bone, steel and sinew."

events.summary: Kaervek vows to build walls from his enemies' flesh.
events.quote: "I shall make walls of their flesh, and their blood will be my mortar."

events.summary: Kaervek says he will stop life since he cannot stop death.
events.quote: "Since I cannot stop death, I choose to stop life."

events.summary: Jolrael says she has hidden from Zhalfir for centuries.
events.quote: "I have hidden from the machinations of Zhalfir for centuries. Why should I join *your* campaign?"

events.summary: Rashida Scalebane measures victories by children freed from dragon nightmares.
events.quote: It is not by the blood of dragons that Rashida measures victories

events.summary: Teferi unified the houses into guilds to serve Zhalfir.
events.quote: An ancient court mage unified the houses into guilds to serve Zhalfir above their own interests.

events.summary: Telim'Tor's troops endure countless assaults.
events.quote: Telim'Tor could no longer recall the exact number of assaults—but his troops could.

events.summary: Sisay recalls throwing fruit to drakes along the Weatherlight.
events.quote: "We threw dried fruit to the drakes that rode the air, streaming along the *Weatherlight'*s side as we sailed amidst the clouds."

events.summary: Asmira declares her faith her shield.
events.quote: "Faith is my shield, and hope is my armor; I am vulnerable only to myself."

events.summary: Mangara reflects that battle is the greatest forge of civilization.
events.quote: "How ironic that the greatest forge of civilization is battle."

events.summary: Shauku denies any master among her minions.
events.quote: "My minions serve me in the light; I serve no one."

events.summary: Rhirhok's goblin allies run afoul of floodgates.
events.quote: "Quick, Rhirhok—teach me to swim!"

events.summary: The pirates gamble with a djinn and lose.
events.quote: ". . . pirates gambled with a djinn and lost the thing more dear than gold."

relations.quote: "Suq'Ata believe in trade; Femeref, alms; Zhalfirins, steel. Be warned, Kaervek—now we are joined."
"Mangara is gone. Who among you doubts that I have taken his power?"
Centuries ago, Mangara won the loyalty of the Quirion not by ruling their minds but by supporting their independence.
But in one terrible instant, they were slain, leaving Asmira as the sole voice of leadership."

relations.note: Unified the houses into guilds for Zhalfir
relations.quote: An ancient court mage unified the houses into guilds to serve Zhalfir above their own interests.
"The Femeref look only to the Sun for healing; they have never truly understood life's cycle."
"Consider the wave: how weak the mother yet how strong the child."
"Life for life: this is the immutable law."
"A treasure to guard other treasures is worth the highest price."
